name: chat-handoff
description: When a chat reaches a token threshold (250k by default, set in the plugin's config), offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Saves a draft first and logs every run to ~/.claude/handoffs/handoff.log

offerAtTokens.title: Offer handoff at (tokens)
offerAtTokens.description: Context size at which the Refresh offer opens. Chats auto-compact near 300k to 324k, so a value above that never offers. Hide and Close wait for 40% of this value more tokens.
